From 47 CFR 25.114(1) (AMDDATE 2026-08-13), addressing: What ITU filing must be made via the FCC before an amateur space station license can be granted?

A license application filed pursuant to § 25.110(b)(2) for a GSO space station or NGSO space station or space-station constellation must comprise a comprehensive proposal and must be submitted on FCC Form 312, Main Form and Schedule S, with attached exhibits required by paragraph (d) of this section.
